name: Asagiri
source:
Although he was born on the mainland, this exotic courtesan took up at Ohygiya by his own choice. He has an elusive personality. His manners are exquisite, but he is a truly self-indulgent lover of women.

(Taken from the [url=https://d3p.co.jp/ohgiya/en/]official English website[/url])
